draft.subject: Getting your first project off the ground
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Following up on our getting started call — sounds like the invite went out, which is a good first step. The next one is creating a first project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real piece of work in there is what makes the rest click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like to follow along.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
